Name: Bewitching Oculus
Information:
**Bewitching Oculus**

The Oculus is a creature that bleeds over into our world from rifts to various Far Realms. It emerges in the Material Plane, attracted by the presence of rational thought among mortals - something it feeds on by disrupting. Its terrifying form, of many fingers wrapping around a milky, dead eye, portrays a frailty that causes its living optic nerve to remain floating above its prey when possible.

traits.name: Cursed Stare
traits.description: At the end of each of the oculus’s turns, it chooses one creature within 60 feet to stare at, exposing them to its cursed gaze. At the start of that creature’s turn, they must choose to close their eyes and are blinded until the start of their next turn, or make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are stunned until the start of their next turn instead, and take 6 (1d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Vulnerable Eye
traits.description: The oculus has disadvantage on saving throws made to resist being blinded.

actions.name: Madness Ray
actions.description: The oculus chooses one target within 60 feet, who it fires a ray of psychic energy like a banshee’s wail at. Its target must make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) thunder damage and 11 (2d10) psychic damage on a failed save. If a creature fails by 5 points or more, the oculus may force them to use their reaction to move up to half their movement speed towards a creature it chooses and make a single weapon attack of the oculus’s choice against them.

actions.name: Shudderhop
actions.description: The oculus teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.
